name: Mulberry Scrolls
source:
Jiang siblings go to the cultivators’ conference in the Unclean Realm. Young Jiang Cheng must establish himself as a worthy Sect Leader and gain respect of the cultivation world. The more respected he is the more say he has in the global matters and his siblings’ future. Will Yunmeng Jiang emerge from the war strong and prosperous and be just that for the years to come?
Oh, and Jiang Cheng can attempt to romance one of the prominent bachelors.

[From the [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/39707967/chapters/99408795]official website[/url]]
translation:
江氏姐弟前往不净世参加修士大会。年轻的江澄必须证明自己有资格成为宗主，并赢得修真界的尊重。他越受敬重，在天下大事和兄弟姐妹的未来上就越有话语权。云梦江氏能否从战争中崛起，变得强盛繁荣，并在此后多年保持如此？
哦，江澄还可以尝试追求几位出众的单身公子之一。
